knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Hot, energised equipment is a burn and electrical hazard.
Internal powered ductwork is outside routine cleaning scope and needs competent specialist work.
Imminent fire risk is escalated, not treated by the cleaner alone.

practicalCriteria: Confirms equipment is cool and isolated before any external clean in a mock kitchen.
Cleans only accessible external surfaces and filters within the authorised scope.
Refuses and escalates a simulated request to clean internal powered ductwork.
passRule: Isolation confirmed, scope respected, and out-of-scope request escalated with a record. Observed by an assessor. Not a licence or certificate.
stopWorkCriteria: Equipment energised or hot during cleaning
Request to clean internal powered ductwork
